safety.title: Is this safe?
safety.intro: Isoko Market is built to protect you. Here's how.
safety.q1: How do mobile money payments stay safe?
safety.a1: Payments for orders are held in escrow — the seller is only paid after you confirm you received your item. If something's wrong, the money isn't released.
safety.q2: What if a deal goes wrong?
safety.a2: You can open a dispute on any order. Our team reviews it and can hold or refund the escrowed money.
safety.q3: How do I know users are real?
safety.a3: Every account is tied to a verified phone number. Users who upload an ID get a Verified badge — look for it before you deal.
safety.q4: Why do you ask for an ID, and is it protected?
safety.a4: ID is optional and only used to award a Verified badge that builds trust. It's stored privately, never shown publicly or sold. Verification unlocks more reach — it's never required to start.
safety.q5: How do I report a scam?
safety.a5: Every listing, job and profile has a Report button. Reports go straight to our moderation team, who can suspend accounts and remove content.
